record.what_it_does: LinkedIn's Marketing API lets developers create and manage LinkedIn ad campaigns, targeting, reporting, leads, matched audiences, and conversion tracking on a user's behalf.
record.auth_notes: Uses 3-legged member authorization (OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow); LinkedIn's 2-legged/client-credentials flow is documented for other LinkedIn APIs but Marketing APIs specifically require member (3-legged) auth.
record.access_notes: Anyone can create a developer app, but each Marketing API product (Advertising, Community Management, Lead Sync, Conversions, Matched Audiences, Events) requires a separate LinkedIn application-review approval; Audience Insights and Media Planning need additional qualification criteria evaluated by LinkedIn; Company Intelligence API is closed to new applicants. Advertising and Community Management APIs also gate a 'Standard' tier behind a further review/demo submission.
record.main_blocker: Per-product LinkedIn app review/approval required, with some products (Audience Insights, Media Planning) further restricted to qualified partners and Company Intelligence closed to new applicants

evidence.quote: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member (user) authorization and API authentication.
Not all APIs support Application Authorization... Marketing APIs you must use Member Authorization
Access to Audience Insights and Media Planning APIs is restricted to developers who meet additional qualification criteria evaluated by LinkedIn.
Available to all developers approved for Advertising API access.

record.open_questions: No published rate-limit figures or fixed review-approval timelines for restricted products; LinkedIn states restricted APIs are evaluated case-by-case with no fixed timeline.
